title: A near-frontal solve can't fix the lens without one known depth
summary: With a near-frontal box and a human scale, fov and camera distance trade off (dolly-zoom family) and the solve drifts. Add one real depth prior: room depth, bed or car length.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: tunnel: prior cell depth 2.7 m (weight 400) -> fov 38.7, camera z 10.07

doc.when: Frontal or nearly frontal references (cut-aways, side sections).

problem.symptom: The solved fov and camera distance wander between runs while the residual stays the same.
problem.cause: Perspective only fixes depth/distance as a ratio when the landmarks are nearly coplanar.
problem.fix: Add a prior on one real depth (weight it strongly).
problem.detect: Solver f and distance move together with no change in rms.
